UI_DataCollectGuide_Context:
<TBH: Task Bar Hero> collects the following information to support Steam Market usage and ensure a fair gaming environment.

[Information collected upon first connection]
- SteamID (collected once)

[Information collected upon detection of abnormal use (cheating)]
- SteamID / AppID / Authentication value
- Game version
- Cumulative playtime
- File integrity status
- Other gameplay information (hero information, stage progress, item information, etc.)

<TBH: Task Bar Hero> follows a data minimization policy, ensuring data is stored only when necessary. This means information is only collected when the use of potential cheat software is detected. As a result, the vast majority of players' information beyond their SteamID will not be stored.

For more details, please review the Terms of Service.
(https://store.steampowered.com//eula/3678970_eula_0)

If you do not wish to play the game, please Exit Game.

UI_TradingStash_Description_Title: How do I receive items purchased from the Market?
UI_TradingStash_Notice1: 1.Depending on Steam Market server status and connectivity, delivery may take some time after purchase.
UI_TradingStash_Notice2: 2.Click the 'Mailbox' button at the top of the menu → press the 'Refresh' button at the bottom to receive your purchased items.
UniqueMod_ArrowRainCriticalCooldown: When a basic attack critically hits, Arrow Rain cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.
UniqueMod_AxeSpinBleedingChance: Axe Spin's chance to cause bleeding increases to 50%.
UniqueMod_ChargeTrapExplosiveCooldown: Each time Explosive Bolt kills a monster, Charge Trap cooldown is reduced by 1 second.
UniqueMod_CrossbowTurretAddAmount: Maximum number of Crossbow Turrets summoned is increased by 1.
UniqueMod_CrossbowTurretCooldown: Crossbow Turret cooldown is reduced by 50%.
UniqueMod_ExplosiveBoltHalf: Explosive Bolt damage and cooldown decrease by 50%.
UniqueMod_IceOrbFreezeToCold: Ice Orb has a 30% chance to freeze chilled enemies on hit.
UniqueMod_ShieldChargeKillCooldown: Killing an enemy with Shield Charge resets its cooldown.
UniqueMod_SkewerShotBleedingStrike: Skewer Shot deals double damage to bleeding enemies.
UniqueMod_SkillBaseAttackCountReduce: Equipped skill requires 1 less basic attack to trigger.
UniqueMod_SkillElementChange: Equipped skill's damage element is changed.
UniqueMod_SlayerLowHpAttackSpeed: Attack Speed is amplified by 1% per 1% missing HP.
UniqueMod_SnowstormEnhanceFrozenEnemy: Snowstorm deals 100% additional damage to frozen enemies.
UniqueMod_SorcererLightningShock: Lightning skill shocks enemies on hit.
UniqueMod_WaveMoveFastestPartyMember: Move between waves at the speed of the fastest party member.
UniqueMod_WaveMoveSlowestPartyExcludeSel: Move between waves at the speed of the slowest party member, excluding yourself.
UniqueMod_WhirlwindFireIgnite: Axe Spin's damage is converted to fire, and bleeding chance becomes ignite chance.
UniqueMod_WrathOfHeavenHeal: While under Wrath of Heaven buff, attacking enemies also casts Heal on allies.
